roots.title: Shared RDS definition and derivation contract
roots.problemStatement: Affected RDS lack portable versioned contracts for inputs, aggregation, reference population, window, metric variant, normalization or constituent mapping.
roots.decisionRequired: Select the mandatory contract and versioning rules for an RDS to be calculable and reviewable; do not decide causal-source eligibility here.
designAlternatives: A: require one fully versioned derivation specification for every executable RDS
B: allow named derivation profiles with explicit application bindings
C: retain narrative RDS as non-executable constructs until a profile is governed
roots.currentSafeState: Preserve every recorded scientific, ontology, architecture and lifecycle state until a later human decision.

roots.title: Cross-level exposure and group-to-person causal semantics
roots.problemStatement: Group, institution and network states do not automatically become exposures experienced by individual targets.
roots.decisionRequired: Choose how membership, eligibility, implementation, contact, actual exposure, perceived exposure and response are represented without inferring a shortcut.
designAlternatives: A: govern an explicit typed CrossLevelExposureMapping object
B: require existing Driver/HappeningType bridge records for every level transition
C: add mandatory exposure-path metadata to cross-level Relationships while retaining current entity classes
roots.currentSafeState: Preserve every recorded scientific, ontology, architecture and lifecycle state until a later human decision.

roots.title: Network State, ScenarioStateDelta and metric recalculation boundary
roots.problemStatement: Node, tie, membership and boundary operations are being confused with empirical interventions, metric recalculation and causal effects.
roots.decisionRequired: Assign network state, state changes, empirical operations, derivations and causal EffectAssertions to explicit non-overlapping representations.
designAlternatives: A: extend typed ScenarioStateDelta operations within Network State V1
B: introduce a governed NetworkStateTransition record distinct from Actions & Events
C: retain current recalculation-only bindings and leave unsupported operations blocked
roots.currentSafeState: Preserve every recorded scientific, ontology, architecture and lifecycle state until a later human decision.

roots.title: Contribution identity and double-count control
roots.problemStatement: One underlying contribution may appear through Relationship plus EffectAssertion, constituent plus aggregate RDS, or state recalculation plus a causal edge.
roots.decisionRequired: Choose whether and how causal contribution identity spans representation classes without turning derivation into causality.
designAlternatives: A: generalize governed contribution groups across Relationship, EffectAssertion and RDS routes
B: retain lineage links and enforce consumer-side mutual exclusion
C: use separate class-specific controls and keep cross-class cases blocked
roots.currentSafeState: Preserve every recorded scientific, ontology, architecture and lifecycle state until a later human decision.

roots.title: Aggregate RDS causal-source independence
roots.problemStatement: A defined aggregate can still double-count constituents or lack an independent aggregate mechanism, temporal order or contextual exposure route.
roots.decisionRequired: Apply one reusable test before adjudicating any individual RDS as an independent causal source.
designAlternatives: A: allow only independently manipulable aggregates with distinct mechanisms
B: allow contextual aggregate exposures with explicit cross-level mapping and contribution control
C: prohibit aggregate causal-source use and retain aggregates as descriptive/derivational
roots.currentSafeState: Preserve every recorded scientific, ontology, architecture and lifecycle state until a later human decision.

roots.title: Active empirical effect versus mechanism-knowledge contract
roots.problemStatement: Two governed bounded effects have evidence for effect existence while mechanismStatus correctly remains UNKNOWN; the current active contract requires non-UNKNOWN mechanism knowledge.
roots.decisionRequired: Decide whether active eligibility always requires mechanism knowledge or whether effect-existence eligibility is a distinct governed dimension.
designAlternatives: A: retain the current contract and keep both bundles inactive
B: create a restricted active empirical-effect class with UNKNOWN mechanism and stronger scope safeguards
C: separate effect-existence eligibility from mechanism-knowledge eligibility
D: retain one active class but add consumer capability restrictions for unknown-mechanism effects
roots.currentSafeState: Preserve every recorded scientific, ontology, architecture and lifecycle state until a later human decision.

roots.title: Construct identity, feature and blocked-metadata governance
roots.problemStatement: Construct overlap, feature-versus-identity questions and blocked scientific metadata are mixed under one ontology backlog class.
roots.decisionRequired: Use separate adjudication tracks for identity equivalence, feature representation, classification and missing scientific metadata.
designAlternatives: A: retain distinct constructs and govern explicit mappings
B: govern identity/merge only when definitions and evidence establish equivalence
C: add feature or dimension representation only through separate ontology governance
roots.currentSafeState: Preserve every recorded scientific, ontology, architecture and lifecycle state until a later human decision.

roots.title: Truthful multi-route source registration contract
roots.problemStatement: Candidate provenance includes DOI/PubMed, publisher, report/book and verified non-PubMed identities with different access depths.
roots.decisionRequired: Define identity and access-depth fields that permit canonical registration without overstating verification.
designAlternatives: A: identifier-specific verification profiles under one source schema
B: one canonical identity record plus separate verification assertions
C: retain unsupported routes in candidate queues until authoritative identifiers exist
roots.currentSafeState: Preserve every recorded scientific, ontology, architecture and lifecycle state until a later human decision.

roots.title: Production Relationship semantic-debt program
roots.problemStatement: Layer audits recorded revision, retype and split proposals, including duplicated cross-Layer reviews, without changing production.
roots.decisionRequired: Govern deduplicated work streams after prerequisite semantics are decided; preserve proposition-level votes for science-changing migrations.
designAlternatives: A: migrate by semantic-defect work stream
B: migrate by Layer after shared architecture decisions
C: retain production and close only independently governable high-value defects
roots.currentSafeState: Preserve every recorded scientific, ontology, architecture and lifecycle state until a later human decision.

roots.title: Targeted evidence and inactive-knowledge program
roots.problemStatement: Eight Layer queues mix high-value exact research, architecture-blocked questions, endpoint mismatch, identification limits and future evidence watch.
roots.decisionRequired: Open only bounded research tasks whose target and representation are stable; keep safe inactive identities available for later evidence.
designAlternatives: A: research only architecture-independent high-value targets first
B: wait for all shared architecture decisions before new evidence work
C: operate parallel evidence-watch and architecture-dependent queues with explicit gates
